mods.name: Couchcraft
mods.description: True single-client split screen. Up to four players on one Minecraft window, one process, one world — controllers first, like the old days.

releases.notes:
**Guest profiles.** Every player now keeps their own save, and it follows them even when they rename.

- **Who's playing?** When a controller presses START, the new player picks a saved profile, makes a new one, or renames one, right in their part of the screen.
- **Remembered per controller.** The profile you last used on a controller is suggested first (★) with the cursor already on it, so coming back is just START, A.
- **Renaming keeps your save.** Each profile has a fixed save ID, so a renamed profile keeps its inventory, XP, advancements and spawn in every world.
- **On-screen keyboard** for naming profiles with a controller. Keyboard players just type.
- **Profiles in the settings** (pause menu → Couch Co-op…, or Ctrl+Shift+C): see who's playing on which profile, rename, delete, or make new profiles. *Add player* and Ctrl+Shift+J open the picker too.
- Your existing Player2-4 guests become the first profiles and keep their saves.

**Install:** Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3, drop `couchcraft-0.2.0.jar` into `mods/` (remove 0.1.0). Fabric API isn't needed.

mods.name: Couchcraft
mods.description: True single-client split screen. Up to four players on one Minecraft window, one process, one world — controllers first, like the old days.

releases.notes:
First release. Real split-screen co-op for **Minecraft Java 26.3** on Fabric: up to four players in one game window, no extra clients.

**Install:** Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ for 26.3, drop `couchcraft-0.1.0.jar` into `mods/`. Fabric API isn't needed.

**Play:** open a singleplayer world, plug in a controller, press START.

- 2, 3 and 4-player layouts, each player with their own camera, HUD, menus, inventory and dimension
- Controllers via SDL3 (Xbox, DualSense, Switch Pro, …): analog movement and look, menu cursor, rumble, player-colour lights
- P1 on keyboard & mouse, a controller, or both
- Couch Co-op settings (pause menu or Ctrl+Shift+C): pick each player's controller, **Vibrate** to find a pad, tune look speed, deadzone and more
- Guest profiles persist with the world: inventory, XP, advancements, spawn
- Pause only when everyone pauses; guests leave without ending the game

**Known limits:** tested on the OpenGL renderer; not compatible with Sodium/Iris; guests can join singleplayer and LAN-host worlds, not online servers. See the README for details.
